findings.element: Shopify stores · store card status "Ready" vs Sync block "Enable" (State 1, after setup)
findings.finding: When a store finishes setup its card says "Ready" and its only remaining CTA is "Map products", while the connect-first alert that told the user to "click Enable" has already disappeared and Enable sits in a different column, so nothing near the completed step points to the required Enable action.
findings.user_impact: Users finishing store setup read "Ready" as done (or go on to mapping), leaving sync Disabled so no stock changes are ever sent, which is the KF-2 "I thought it was finished" drop-off pattern.
findings.suggested_fix: While sync is Disabled and at least one store is ready, show a next-step line on the ready store card (or reinstate the top alert) saying "Store is ready. Click Enable to start sending stock changes" with the Enable action.

evidence.action: State 1: Connect store (My ceramic plates) → Choose location → Save → Open Settings
evidence.observed: Alert "Connect a Shopify store first … After that, click Enable." is gone from the page as soon as the store connects; after Open Settings the card reads "Ready … 1 item needs mapping … Map products" while the Sync block in the middle column reads "State: Disabled / Enable" with no prompt linking the two.

findings.element: Activity tab · Held row (Reason "Item not matched", Actions "–") and Retry held and failed
findings.finding: A Held change shows the reason "Item not matched" but has no action to fix it, and Retry only returns "Nothing was sent: fix the reason first." without saying where to fix it.
findings.user_impact: Users checking what was sent hit a dead end on held changes and must work out by themselves that the fix is on the Mappings tab, then come back to retry.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a row action on held "Item not matched" rows (e.g. "Map item") that opens the Mappings tab filtered to that store and product.

evidence.action: State 2: Overview Held count → Activity tab filtered Held → click "Retry 1 held"
evidence.observed: Row "Bill #1045 · Plate seconds (B-grade) · – · +12 · Held · Item not matched · –" with no row action; Retry → toast "Nothing was sent: fix the reason first." with no link or pointer to Mappings.

findings.element: Overview · Stock check block (State 3, one nightly check failed)
findings.finding: The block shows "The last check of My good flowers failed … so its stock wasn't compared" and, at the same time, a green check "Stock is the same in QuickBooks and Shopify." with no store scope, so the two messages contradict each other.
findings.user_impact: Users may trust the green all-clear and skip Compare now, leaving any difference in My good flowers unnoticed until the next night.
findings.suggested_fix: While a store's last check failed, scope the success line to the stores actually compared (e.g. "My ceramic plates: stock is the same") or hide it until Compare now succeeds.

evidence.action: Switch to State 3 and look at the Overview Stock check block before clicking Compare now
evidence.observed: Block text: "error The last check of My good flowers failed (Oct 2, 2026 02:30), so its stock wasn't compared. Compare now · check_circle Stock is the same in QuickBooks and Shopify."

findings.element: Activity tab · table row order with Store = All stores
findings.finding: With all stores shown, rows are grouped by store instead of sorted by the leading Time column, so a later change appears below earlier ones.
findings.user_impact: Users scanning "what was sent" by time misread the sequence and can miss the most recent change for the second store.
findings.suggested_fix: Sort the All stores view by Time, newest first, across all stores.

evidence.action: State 3 → Activity tab, Store = All stores, no status filter
evidence.observed: Times in row order: Oct 1 16:58, 15:20, 11:05 (My ceramic plates), then 14:40, 12:15 (My good flowers); 14:40 appears below 11:05.

gaps: Enable before any store is ready (State 1 initial): the map records Enable as disabled=false with a tooltip but not which state, so whether Enable can be clicked with no ready store, and what happens, is unknown

Retry after fixing the reason: Plate seconds was mapped on the Mappings tab, but Retry on the Held event was never exercised afterwards, so whether the held change is then sent (or auto-retried) is unknown
Overview "Review differences" when more than one store has differences: only the one-store case was exercised (it jumps straight to that comparison)
Overview Stock check block after differences are resolved (Update Shopify qty / Ignore / new Compare now): block state afterwards was not captured
Connect store dialog once some stores are already connected: whether connected stores are still listed, and whether a card's own Connect store preselects that store, was not recorded
Mappings select: picking a QuickBooks item marked "used by" another product was never exercised, so the conflict behaviour is unknown
Failed Activity events and Run now beyond a toast: not available in the prototype
